sentences: An API source, described by the OpenAPI documents orders.
Write calls are on, for the calls named below. Delete calls are off.
The write call orders/createOrder is open to the roles admin.
Who may read: everyone who is signed in.
Who may change: admins only.

sources:
  - name: shop
    kind: api
    read_only: true
    specs:

  - name: shop
    kind: api
    read_only: false
    specs:
      orders:
        operations:

            expose_mutation: true
            allowed_roles:

    capabilities:
